thread:
sophie: Follow-up from the PM: vendor chain instability (cloud control-plane + auth + model-registry webhooks). Need owners, short deadlines, and a recurring-pattern rule. Who picks what?

marco: I'll take the cloud control-plane mitigation: runbook for regional failover, warm-pool audit, and a routing downgrade test to lighter model variants. Plan: stage run next Tue.

tinisha: I'll own auth resilience: sticky-token cache + safe rolling reissue. Spike in staging with 2% canary, rollback if auth_5xx spikes >0.25%.

rachel: I'll handle model-registry durability: buffered webhook consumer, DLQ after 4 retries, idempotency keys, and an S3 backstop. PR target in 10 days.

ops-bot: Created INC-6001 (marco) control-plane-failover, INC-6002 (tinisha) auth-sticky-reissue, INC-6003 (rachel) registry-buffer.

sophie: Acceptance criteria to add to tracker:
- control-plane: routing-only failover with <1% user-error delta
- auth: canary auth_5xx <= 0.1% over 48h and P95 latency < baseline +50ms
- registry: end-to-end webhook delivery >=99.95% on 95th replay

marco: I'll produce a short runbook and checklist for the stage run. Target doc by +3d.

tinisha: Spike checklist: staging FF, token_cache_size=8k, sticky_ttl=1800s, canary=2%. Demo by +5d.

rachel: Buffer design notes: at-least-once delivery, dedupe via idempotency key, metrics for dup_count and dlq_rate. Will add CI synthetic replay.

sophie: Recurrence rule: label "recurring-pattern" if same vendor-related outage occurs 3x in 90 days -> contract review + exec alert. Owners get weekly pings; auto-assign to oncall after 72h if owner unavailable.

ops-bot: Weekly owner pings enabled for INC-6001/6002/6003. Follow-up sync in 14 days (thread pinned).

marco: I'll send calendar invite for the stage failover test.

tinisha: Will post canary dashboard link here when ready.

rachel: Posting design doc in #eng-ml shortly.

sophie: Thanks. Short sync in 14 days to validate progress. :thumbsup:
